headings.usage: Use for all major section headings, hero text, and manifesto numbers. Ensure tight letter spacing (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter).

body.usage: Use for paragraphs, UI elements, and admin panel text. Ensure good readability.

mono.usage: Use for overlines, labels, and small metadata (like dates, categories) with uppercase and wide tracking (tracking-[0.2em]).

rules: Never use pure black #000000, use tinted deep void #0A0A0A for base.
Avoid harsh pure white on pure black, use off-white (zinc-100/200) for text.
No full screen generic gradients. Keep backgrounds solid with potential subtle radial spotlights to highlight imagery.

visual_enhancers.textures: Add a fixed full-screen SVG noise/grain overlay (opacity-20 to opacity-30, pointer-events-none) to create a film-like cinematic texture.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use flat solid surfaces or extremely delicate Crystal Glass (bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl border-white/10) for sticky headers. DO NOT use completely transparent backgrounds where text overlays imagery.
visual_enhancers.borders: Use 1px borders with very low opacity (border-white/10) to define areas without looking boxed.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient diffuse shadows. Not highly visible on dark mode, so rely on 1px borders or subtle light bleed for depth.

component_rules.buttons: Minimalist. Either pure text with a dramatic underline on hover, or sharp rectangular buttons with border-white/20 and hover:bg-white hover:text-black transition-colors.
component_rules.cards: DO NOT use standard Shadcn cards for the public portfolio. Build custom flat, clipped-frame containers with generous negative space. For Admin Panel, use standard flat Shadcn cards with border-white/10 and sharp corners.
component_rules.forms: Admin panel only. Use Shadcn Input/Form but style them with dark mode: bg-transparent, border-white/10, text-white. No heavy rounded corners.
component_rules.navigation: Sticky nav. Transparent at top, turns into Crystal Glass on scroll. Logo on left, text links on right.

grids.portfolio_gallery: MODE A: TETRIS GRID. Asymmetrical bento layout. Use wide gaps (gap-8 or gap-12). Mix orientations (col-span-12 row-span-2, col-span-4 row-span-1). Do not perfectly fill the grid. Leave empty cells for tension.
grids.admin_dashboard: MODE B: High Density Grid. gap-4, structured, strictly functional.

layouts.spacing: Generous. p-12, p-16, p-24, py-32 for sections. Let the photography breathe.
layouts.hero: Cinematic full screen or min-h-[90vh]. Masked line-by-line headline reveal. A central or heavily asymmetrical image focal point.
layouts.about: Numbered manifesto chapters. Use huge numbers (e.g. 01, 02) in serif, with editorial layout for the text.

motion.scrolling: Use Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling across the app.
motion.reveals: Use Framer Motion for scroll reveals (fade up, slow slight scale on images).
motion.hero_headline: Kinetic masked line-by-line reveal (using overflow-hidden wrappers on text lines and framer-motion y-translation).
motion.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee. Extremely slow editorial ribbon (serif, small text, massive gaps like gap-32) running across the bottom or between sections.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images uses a subtle gradient overlay (e.g. bg-gradient-to-t from-black/80 to-transparent) or text-shadow.
accessibility.animations: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for all framer-motion setups.

media.images: Photography is the hero. Use spotlight treatment (brighter in center, fading to dark edges) or clipped frames. max-h-[80vh] on mobile to prevent blocking.
media.videos: Embed YouTube videos in an elegant 16:9 aspect-ratio container with border-white/10. Add subtle scale effect on hover if interactive.

hero.description: Dark moody cinematography portrait (Woman standing in dark)
hero.category: Hero Background or Main Focus Subject

gallery_portraits.description: Artistic portrait with dramatic shadow play

about.description: Silhouette of a cameraman holding equipment

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required packages: yarn add framer-motion @studio-freight/lenis react-fast-marquee @phosphor-icons/react
Ensure Javascript (.js) is used, DO NOT use TypeScript (.tsx).
Build the Admin panel with Shadcn components (tables, inputs, dialogs) keeping it dark-themed and functional.
Build the public facing site with custom HTML/Tailwind, avoiding Shadcn generic cards to maintain the Awwwards-level design.
Add 'data-testid' to ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links).
Hero section: Build a masked line-by-line reveal using framer-motion for the H1. Add a subtle parallax effect.
Implement Lenis smooth scroll globally in the layout component.
For the photo gallery, build an asymmetrical CSS grid (Tetris grid) and implement a simple lightbox when an image is clicked.
About section must feature numbered manifesto chapters (e.g. 01, 02) in large serif font.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Avoid generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters where appropriate.
MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Target specific properties.
MUST NOT center align the app container in CSS (.App { text-align: center; }).
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Include subtle grain textures for the dark cinematic feel.
Do NOT use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.
Prioritize pre-existing Shadcn components for interactive logic but heavily customize their look.
